== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (<code>1250_80</code>, Virtual Block 5 slip 81), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. No published image shows this text: the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB5-81-Bravo_Fighter.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB5-L-bravofighter-pre.gif]]) both show the original text of [[Bravo Fighter (V) (Virtual Block 5)]].

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), unchanged in every capture to 11 January 2013. The card list drops icons; icons are drawn as on the printed slip.
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “May add one astromech. During battle, may target a starship with no character piloting. Draw destiny. If destiny > defense value, target hit. Permanent pilot provides ability of 4. Immune to attrition < 3.”
* '''Made:''' 8 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 71): the card's own Virtual Legacy card <code>1005_L5397</code> (printed frame, Decipher art <code>14_58</code>, title, lore, icons, slip number, Virtual Block 5 set mark) with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
